messages.text: BL-2087 🎵 in progress — BL-1584's sampled-reach-floor send gate checks a coder's first send of a ticket against the parcel's base on main, so a first-hop parcel that adds a sampled-low property test is refused - today a coder that took the ticket from a Work note has no received commit, the gate sends silently, and at least 13 sampled-low files landed after the gate shipped (two went red in QA on 2026-10-08)
